QuestInfo.name: Examine the Hut in the Swamp
QuestInfo.0: JM From tha Streetz has a job for you.
QuestInfo.1: Go to the Hut in the Swamp and look inside the Knocked Trash Can. The hut is in the #m103030100#.
QuestInfo.2: When you told JM about the monsters in the Hut in the Swamp, he looked worried. What's going on here?

0.0: Go to the Hut in the Swamp in the #m103030100# and bring me the papers in the Knocked Trash Can. I'm supposed to go myself, but I'm too busy, and you're the only one I'd trust this job with. You game?

yes.0: Don't tell anyone else about this. Only reason I'm giving you the job is 'cause you did such good work for me before.

no.0: Believe me, the pay's good. Sure you won't reconsider?

yes.0: What do you mean, the Hut in the Swamp was an ambush? Hold on, lemme think...
yes.1: I know what's going on here. Nella and Matthias are up to something. Anyway, thanks.

default.0: Look in the Knocked Trash Can in the Hut in the Swamp.
